language.script: Cyrillic (Inner Mongolia, China uses traditional vertical script)

terrainDescription.en: Vast steppe and the Gobi desert

plate.color: black on white, red Soyombo national symbol on left

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Distinctive white bowling-pin-shaped bollards with two red stripes near the top — a fairly unique Mongolia clue

utilityPole.transformerMount: Wooden poles often braced with supporting stone blocks at the base; white lamp posts and three-striped pedestrian-crossing signage common; strong Russian/Soviet infrastructure influence overall

historicalContext.zh: 主體為蒙古族，歷史上以遊牧生活與帳篷（蒙古包）聚落型態著稱。
historicalContext.en: Majority Mongol, with a historically nomadic lifestyle and ger (yurt) settlement patterns.
